I'm often filled with self-doubt, and struggle to see my own merits, acknowledge my own accomplishments. The inner monologue is hard to satisfy.  It finds it hard to accept if a job was well done.

So when the voice finally quitens. When it doesn't nag at my mind and distract me from purpose.  When doubt doesn't strangle creativity... These are the moments of pure joy. These are the moments to live for. The quiet nod from peers that you've done something beyond expectation.  The accredit for helping a dream be born.  The beauty of the people around me, and the beauty in them finding the beauty in a calamity like me. The things that quiet that voice, and let me see, if just for a minute; that I may have something to offer after all.

But I don't want to keep relying on others for the validation of my self-worth. I want to feel the bumps of accomplishment for myself. Be proud of the small successes to give me the belief to strive for the big ones.

So I'm creating a space. :) A space to retreat. To get lost in education. Lost in improvement.  Lost in creation. And there I hope to find more of myself, so I'm no longer lost.
